title: Amitabh Bachchan, Amish Tripathi-Backed AAA Game ‘The Age of Bhaarat’ Taps India’s Annapurna Studios for Motion Capture (EXCLUSIVE)
description: “The Age of Bhaarat,” the AAA video game from Tara Gaming, has signed on with A&M MoCap Lab in Hyderabad for its motion capture production. The fac
body:
“The Age of Bhaarat,” the AAA video game from Tara Gaming, has signed on with A&M MoCap Lab in Hyderabad for its motion capture production. The facility was jointly set up by Annapurna Studios and Mihira Visual Labs.

	Tara Gaming was co-founded by Amitabh Bachchan, author Amish Tripathi and veteran game producer Nouredine Abboud, with “The White Tiger” producer Mukul Deora on the board as director and transmedia producer. The company has bases in Pune, London and Paris.
	

	The lab counts Hollywood company Animatrik Film Design as its technology partner and houses what it bills as the biggest mocap stage in the country, kitted out with Vicon Series cameras. It offers capture of both body and face along with real-time animation and post-production. Recent credits include upcoming features “Varanasi” and “Baahubali: Eternal War,” as well as large animated productions.

	Tara Gaming is pitching “The Age of Bhaarat” as India’s first AAA action-adventure game in the dark-fantasy mold to draw on the country’s epics. The game is being built in Unreal Engine by a team that now numbers more than 205 people worldwide, and already has store pages on Steam and the Epic Games Store.

	The studio’s stated goal is to tell stories that are “recognizably Indian, globally relatable” and to use the game as the foundation of a cinematic universe that starts with gaming rather than film.

	“‘The Age of Bhaarat’ reflects our ambition to create a distinctive AAA gaming experience for a global audience,” said Nicolas Granatino, executive chair of Tara Gaming. “India has an exceptional talent pool and an established production ecosystem. Our collaboration with Annapurna Studios brings together our gaming vision and the studio’s legacy and motion capture expertise. We believe partnerships like these can contribute to the future of global gaming while strengthening India’s position in the industry.”
	

	C. V. Rao, chief technology officer of Annapurna Studios, said the company was looking forward to applying its mocap know-how to the game, drawing on its history in Indian cinema and its spending on production technology.

	“We see exciting potential in the convergence of filmmaking and gaming and are pleased to contribute to a project with global ambitions,” Rao said.

	Both companies are framing the tie-up as part of the push behind India’s AVGC sector – animation, visual effects, gaming and comics – and in keeping with the spirit of the government’s Make in India initiative, with local talent and infrastructure put to work on gaming IP built for a worldwide market.

schema.headline: Amitabh Bachchan, Amish Tripathi-Backed AAA Game ‘The Age of Bhaarat’ Taps India’s Annapurna Studios for Motion Capture (EXCLUSIVE)

title: Former Bond Villain Rami Malek Says Robert Pattinson Will Be an ‘Extraordinary’ 007: ‘I Could Not Be More Proud’
description:
Rami Malek is giving Robert Pattinson’s James Bond casting his stamp of approval.

	“I’ve known Rob for quite some time and I could not be more pro
body:
Rami Malek is giving Robert Pattinson’s James Bond casting his stamp of approval.

	“I’ve known Rob for quite some time and I could not be more proud,” the “Bohemian Rhapsody” actor recently told People. “I mean, the fact that people are recognizing, maybe they all know, how talented that man is… We’ve worked together and we’ve become quite close friends and it’s been lovely to just share this moment with him.”
	

	Malek and Pattinson co-starred in “Breaking Dawn – Part 2,” the fifth “Twilight” movie, in 2012. But Malek’s opinion may hold even more weight given he comes from the world of 007; the actor played Bond villain Lyutsifer Safin in 2021’s “No Time to Die,” Daniel Craig’s final outing as the spy.

	Malek also told the outlet that he and the “Batman” actor have been “texting back and forth” since the news was announced on Monday. “And I think for the world to see that he’s going to be quite extraordinary — and that’s coming from a villain!” The actor declined to confirm if he’d consider making a return to the franchise: “I don’t know. It’s his moment now. It’s definitely Rob’s moment.”

	Pattinson’s announcement as the next Bond put an end to long-swirling rumors surrounding which actor would step into the role. Other actors in the mix included Callum Turner, Jack Lowden, Nicholas Hoult, Josh O’Connor, Tom Francis, Aaron Taylor-Johnson, Harris Dickinson and even Harry Styles. Denis Villeneuve will direct the forthcoming film from Amazon MGM.

	“James Bond is one of the most legendary characters in cinema, and to be entrusted with 007 is the honor of a lifetime,” Pattinson said in a statement. “I’m deeply grateful to Denis, Amy, David, Tanya and everyone at Amazon MGM Studios for their belief in me. To say this role is a dream come true is an understatement. I couldn’t be more excited about this partnership and the work ahead with this fantastic team.”
	

	And while Malek might not be tossing his hat into the ring for the villain role, Variety’s top picks for the part include Riz Ahmed, Timothée Chalamet, Idris Elba, Michael Fassbender, Rebecca Ferguson, Kristen Stewart and more.

schema.headline: Former Bond Villain Rami Malek Says Robert Pattinson Will Be an ‘Extraordinary’ 007: ‘I Could Not Be More Proud’

title: Ron Howard Says a Jim Carrey ‘Grinch’ Sequel Won’t Get Made Unless ‘It Has a Chance to Be Great’: We’re Moving ‘Cautiously’
description: Months after a “How the Grinch Stole Christmas” sequel was announced, director Ron Howard is setting the record straight on what it would take for
body:
Months after a “How the Grinch Stole Christmas” sequel was announced, director Ron Howard is setting the record straight on what it would take for the follow-up film to actually come to fruition.

	“I just have to caution everybody that Jim [Carrey] and I aren’t gonna go forward unless we think we have a great script, and we don’t even have a script right now,” Howard told People. “We have really good writers and an idea that I’m excited about that I think is very much in keeping with the spirit of Dr. Seuss, his blend of comedy and fantasy. So I’m very pleased with what we have to work with, but I don’t wanna make any promises that it’s happening because Jim and I are aligned on one thing — we’re not gonna go forward unless we believe it has a chance to be great.”
	

	Howard continued, noting that the duo feels so “proud of the original movie.” “We feel so fortunate, because it takes a little bit of luck for a movie to come together and become an evergreen the way that film has. And the following, the fact that it’s become a tradition in a lot of households is something that means a great deal to all of us involved, Jim and I in particular.”

	But Howard isn’t ruling out a sequel in its eternity. “We’re gonna move cautiously but hopefully toward another movie because we both believe in the premise,” he said. “With a little luck, we’ll get to revisit that world.”

	The original Christmas classic first premiered back in 2000 and was a box office hit, earning more than $350 million. Carrey, who starred as the Grinch and would reprise his role for the sequel, has long been outspoken about the toll the specific effects makeup needed to transform into the green creature took on him.
	

	Last year, Howard told Vulture that the actor “started having panic attacks” during the early days of filming because of how uncomfortable the transformation was on his body, adding: “I would see him lying down on the floor in between setups with a brown paper bag. Literally on the floor. He was miserable.” Howard also revealed that Carrey was “ready to give his” $20 million salary back.

schema.headline: Ron Howard Says a Jim Carrey ‘Grinch’ Sequel Won’t Get Made Unless ‘It Has a Chance to Be Great’: We’re Moving ‘Cautiously’

title: Thom Velde, Former AMC Theatres Executive, Dies at 83
description:
Thomas Velde, who served as head film buyer at AMC Theatres during his 27 years at the exhibitor, died Oct. 31. He was 83.

	Velde died of cancer a
body:
Thomas Velde, who served as head film buyer at AMC Theatres during his 27 years at the exhibitor, died Oct. 31. He was 83.

	Velde died of cancer at his home in Rancho Mirage, Calif..

	For 27 years, he worked at AMC Theatres, where he negotiated film agreements with domestic and international studios while also overseeing the entertainment company’s Canadian operations and real estate ventures. Following his time at AMC, he worked independently in motion picture distribution and would consult for clients that included Microspace Communications and CJ America.
	

	Velde is survived by his wife, Deborah; his daughters, Andrea Ter-Velde and Courtney Ter-Velde, and their husbands, John McLoughlin and Greg Horton; his son, Sam; stepsons Matthew Castillo and Spencer Castillo and their wives, Crissy Castillo and Claire Castillo; grandchildren Aubrey Long and Jack Long; and step-grandchildren Jackson Castillo, Sammy Castillo, Cruz Castillo, Bianca Castillo and Capri Castillo.

	A celebration of life will be held Dec. 8 at 3 p.m. at Woodland Hills Community Church. Donations can be made to the Will Rogers Motion Picture Pioneers Foundation or the Motion Picture and Television Fund, both of which serve the industry community Velde was a part of.

	“Thom was an avid golfer and a devoted college football fan,” his family noted. “Above all, he loved his family and friends, who will remember his strength of character, his generosity and the way he made time for the people in his life. He was always willing to lend a hand and had a special gift for keeping friendships alive over the years.”

schema.headline: Thom Velde, Former AMC Theatres Executive, Dies at 83

title: ‘Dancing With the Stars’ Sets First-Ever Live Finale for Season 35
description:
For the first time in “Dancing With the Stars” history, the ballroom competition show will air its finale live. 

	The three-hour finale will air o
body:
For the first time in “Dancing With the Stars” history, the ballroom competition show will air its finale live. 

	The three-hour finale will air on Nov. 24 from 8:00-11:00 p.m. ET, 7:00-10:00 p.m. CT, 6:00-9:00 p.m. MT and 5:00-8:00 p.m. PT on ABC and Disney+. The finale will re-air from 8:00-11:00 p.m. PT and stream the next day on Hulu.

	Currently in its 35th season, six celebrities remain in the competition heading into Tuesday night’s semi-finals: Tatyana Ali, Ezra Frech, Amber Glenn, Maura Higgins, Harry Shum Jr. and Connor Wood. The following week, the remaining couples will compete for the Len Goodman Mirrorball Trophy, performing three routines each: a Judges’ Choice Dance, the return of the Instant Dance Challenge and a Freestyle.
	

	The season’s September premiere reached a strong 6.7 million viewers, a 24% increase from the performance of the Season 34 premiere. The episode also marked the series’ best opener in six years, since Season 29 launched with 8.1 million viewers in 2020.

	And the audience is still watching along. “Dancing with the Stars” hit a season high with 6.91 million same-day viewers during last week’s Grammy Night.

	Season 35 cast members also included now-eliminated celebrities Jenna Dewan, Jackson Olson, Julia Stiles, Ciara Miller, Conner Leavitt, Guillermo Rodriguez, Taylor Hanson, Tyler Cameron, Sarah Jane Nader and Giada De Laurentiis. The reigning champions are Robert Irwin and pro Whitney Carson, who took home the Mirrorball Trophy in Season 34. 

	“Dancing with the Stars” is produced in front of a live audience by BBC Studios Los Angeles Productions.

schema.headline: ‘Dancing With the Stars’ Sets First-Ever Live Finale for Season 35

title: Indian Mythology Meets Mumbai Noir in Animated Feature ‘Bombay Eternal’ From ‘Rana Naidu’ Producer Locomotive Global, AI Outfit Studio Blo (EXCLUSIVE)
description: Figures drawn from Indian mythology are headed for the streets of a stylized modern-day Mumbai in “Bombay Eternal,” an animated neo-noir crime fant
body:
Figures drawn from Indian mythology are headed for the streets of a stylized modern-day Mumbai in “Bombay Eternal,” an animated neo-noir crime fantasy from “Rana Naidu” producer Locomotive Global and AI-native film company Studio Blo, which have released a first teaser.

	The project is planned as a feature film for eventual theatrical release in international markets, and the story will unfold across multiple parts. The partners are building it as a franchise from the outset and want the kind of worldwide reach achieved by “Ne Zha,” “Arcane,” “KPop Demon Hunters” and the “Spider-Verse” films.
	

	The story borrows characters and tales from Indian mythology and drops them into an original present-day setting where crime, magic and mystery mix with themes of redemption. The filmmakers have played freely with familiar archetypes, recasting them in a more modern story designed to be accessible worldwide. The teaser gives a first look at some of the main characters and locations, and shows off a visual style that pairs the bustle of the city with an animation approach that crosses genres.

	Locomotive Global’s slate also includes a Tamil-language horror film with Trisha Krishnan.

	“The world of ‘Bombay Eternal’ has been in the making for more than two decades. What began as an idea set in Manhattan has evolved considerably, but the core ambition has remained the same: to take characters and ideas inspired by our mythology and place them in a contemporary world in a way that feels cinematic, unexpected and globally accessible. Our partnership with Studio Blo is about finding the right creative and production ecosystem to finally realize that vision,” said Sunder Aaron, Locomotive Global’s founder and CEO.
	

	Studio Blo, which recently set an international series with “Elizabeth” director Shekhar Kapur, was co-founded by Dipankar Mukherjee, a filmmaker who also works as a creative technologist. The company has devised a look for the film that the team calls “painterly cinematic,” setting illustrated, painting-like foreground elements against deep, film-style environments. It is also contributing its in-house technology, production pipelines and global tech partnerships.

	Over the past year, teams from both companies have worked out how the film will look and sound. Recruits include U.K.-based musicians and voice actors, along with production designers, cinematographers and artists drawn from Europe and the U.S.

	“What drew us to this project was the opportunity to build a world rather than simply produce a film. The mythology gives us an incredibly rich foundation, but the visual language, characters and environments we are creating are distinctly our own,” said Mukherjee, who is also Studio Blo’s CEO.

	The partners said new production tools are being folded into the workflow to keep the film efficient and financially viable. They stressed, however, that craft, storytelling and design remain at the center of the project, along with the considerable human labor behind it.

	More of the film will be revealed in stages. Much of its wider story world is being kept under wraps for now.

	Indian artists and technicians have long worked on major international animation projects. With “Bombay Eternal,” the partners are betting India can now originate animated IP of its own, much as Korean and Chinese animation have shown that stories rooted in one culture can find audiences far from home.

	Watch the teaser here:

schema.headline: Indian Mythology Meets Mumbai Noir in Animated Feature ‘Bombay Eternal’ From ‘Rana Naidu’ Producer Locomotive Global, AI Outfit Studio Blo (EXCLUSIVE)

title: Longtime Exec Howard Lee Departs as Skydance Confirms New Cable Structure and Division Name Under Channing Dungey
description: Skydance’s merged cable networks has a new division name: Skydance Global Cable Media.  Warner Bros. TV Group and U.S. Networks head Channing Dunge
body:
Skydance’s merged cable networks has a new division name: Skydance Global Cable Media.  Warner Bros. TV Group and U.S. Networks head Channing Dungey also revealed the structure under the new entity, which combines the Warner Bros. Discovery and Paramount Global cable networks under one roof.

	As part of that new organization, longtime exec Howard Lee, who had most recently served as chief creative officer of US Networks, is exiting after 28 years at Discovery. Lee’s oversight had included Discovery Channel, TLC, HGTV, Food Network and more.
	

	“One of the hardest parts of any transition is saying goodbye to talented leaders who have contributed so much and, just as importantly, have been trusted colleagues, friends, and mentors,” Dungey said in a memo to staff. “I want to express my sincere thanks to Howard Lee for his excellent leadership. I’m deeply grateful for the immense talent, commitment, and passion he brought to Warner Bros. Discovery’s US Networks over the years and wish him the best in his future endeavors.”

	As part of merging a huge portfolio of more than 50 cable networks, Dungey divided them into four buckets: unscripted lifestyle, broad-based entertainment, talent/music/live and comedy/animation.

	In unscripted lifestyle, Food Network prexy Betsy Sanner Ayala will add Discovery, HGTV and Magnolia oversight, with Discovery head of content Joe Boyle reporting to her.

	In broad-based entertainment, TNT/TBS/ID president Jason Sarlanis will also now oversee TLC, with TLC head of content Alon Orstein reporting to him.

	In the talent/music/live division, OWN president Tina Perry will add BET and MTV/VH1 to her oversight. Sitarah Pendelton will continue as head of content for MTV/VH1, Brian Rikuda will serve as head of BET, and Aisha Summers-Burke will continue as head of BET content. All three execs report to Perry. (BET Media Group head Louis Carr announced his exit on Monday.)
	

	Nickelodeon and Nickelodeon Animation Studios, Adult Swim, Cartoon Network, Warner Bros. Animation, Cartoon Network Studios and Hanna-Barbera Studios Europe will now be part of Skydance Television Animation, overseen by president Michael Ouweleen. Ouweleen will also continue oversight of Cartoon Network and Adult Swim. Overseeing the studios assets (Nickelodeon Animation Studios, Warner Bros. Animation, Cartoon Network Studios, and Hanna-Barbera Studios Europe) will be Peter Girardi and Alec Botnick, both reporting to Ouweleen. Botnick will continue to oversee Nickelodeon programming with Laurel Weir. Meanwhile, Comedy Central oversight will remain with Ari Pearce, reporting to Ouweleen.

	As for Lee, he first joined Discovery Inc. in 1998 as VP of Travel Channel Development; he later helped launch Planet Green, then moved to TLC, where he was first exec VP of production and development and later rose to president of TLC originals — before taking over as preident of Discovery Channel Networks and TLC in 2022. He was named chief creative officer of US Networks at Warner Bros. Discovery in Dec. 2024. 

	Lee developed and launched pop cultural institutions like “90 Day Fiancé,” “Toddlers & Tiaras,” “Sister Wives,” “Dr. Pimple Popper” and “Baylen Out Loud.” Under his watch, Puppy Bowl delivered its biggest audience in eight years and Shark Week posted its largest year-over-year ratings growth in over a decade. 

	Here is Dungey’s memo:

	Hi Team,

	As we bring together our renowned cable brands across Warner Bros. Discovery and Paramount, I’m pleased to share an organizational update that will help us leverage the full strength of our combined portfolio and position us for future success.

	Our newly formed group will be called Skydance Global Cable Media and will encompass a premier roster of 50+ cable networks, including such iconic brands as Adult Swim, BET, Comedy Central, Discovery, Food Network, HGTV, ID, MTV, TLC, and Nickelodeon, among many others. Together, these brands deliver culture-defining entertainment, compelling kids and family programming, and leading lifestyle content to audiences around the world.

	The breadth and quality of programming this team delivers is truly unmatched, from Adult Swim’s Rick & Morty to TLC’s “90 Day Fiancé” franchise, from Discovery’s “Puppy Bowl” and “Shark Week” to the Soul Train Awards on BET and the VMAs on MTV, our brands are bigger than television. They are part of our audiences’ daily lives in meaningful and unique ways, and I look forward to stewarding their legacies into the future alongside you.
	

	As we look ahead, our focus is clear: create exceptional stories, unlock the full potential of our programming, franchises and brands, and deepen our relationship with audiences. The quality and reach of our programming, together with the extraordinary talent across our organization, give us a strong foundation for what comes next.

	To help achieve these strategic goals, we have created four distinct segments within the group. I’m pleased to announce our new structure and creative leadership for Skydance Global Cable Media:

	Unscripted Lifestyle: Betsy Sanner Ayala, currently President of Food Network, will continue in that role and also oversee Discovery, HGTV, and Magnolia. Joe Boyle will continue as Head of Content for Discovery, reporting into Betsy.

	Broad-Based Entertainment: Jason Sarlanis, currently President of TNT, TBS, and ID, will continue in that role, and will also oversee TLC. Alon Orstein will continue as Head of Content for TLC, reporting into Jason.

	Talent, Music, and Live: Tina Perry, currently President of OWN, will continue in that role and add BET and MTV/VH1 to her purview. Sitarah Pendelton will continue as Head of Content for MTV/VH1, Brian Rikuda will serve as Head of BET, and Aisha Summers-Burke will continue as Head of BET Content, all reporting into Tina.

	Our fourth network group will be comprised of Comedy and Animation. Skydance Television is now the home of some of the most incredible animation networks and studios in the industry, including Nickelodeon and Nickelodeon Animation Studios, Adult Swim, Cartoon Network, Warner Bros. Animation, Cartoon Network Studios, and Hanna-Barbera Studios Europe. I’m pleased to say that all these beloved assets will now be together as part of Skydance Television Animation, and this group will be overseen by Michael Ouweleen, President. Michael will also continue with day-to-day oversight of Cartoon Network and Adult Swim. Reporting to Michael and leading the work overseeing the studios assets (Nickelodeon Animation Studios, Warner Bros. Animation, Cartoon Network Studios, and Hanna-Barbera Studios Europe) will be Peter Girardi and Alec Botnick. Alec will also continue to oversee programming on Nickelodeon along with Laurel Weir. In addition, Comedy Central will roll up to Michael, with Ari Pearce continuing day-to-day oversight of the network.
	

	I’m excited about this new structure and feel confident that this incredible team of leaders will help defend our core business while building out a multi-platform strategy for these brands that will allow us to reach audiences wherever they may be. We are continuing to work through the process and will share more about the international business in the coming weeks.

	One of the hardest parts of any transition is saying goodbye to talented leaders who have contributed so much and, just as importantly, have been trusted colleagues, friends, and mentors. I want to express my sincere thanks to Howard Lee for his excellent leadership. I’m deeply grateful for the immense talent, commitment, and passion he brought to Warner Bros. Discovery’s US Networks over the years and wish him the best in his future endeavors.

	I know we have a lot of work ahead and I am excited to get started. With our unrivaled portfolio of brands, incredibly talented teams, and shared passion for making great TV, there is nothing we can’t achieve together.

	Best,

	Channing Dungey

schema.headline: Longtime Exec Howard Lee Departs as Skydance Confirms New Cable Structure and Division Name Under Channing Dungey

title: Emma Chamberlain, Wesley Wang, Aryna Sabalenka and More Unveil New Projects for YouTube
description: Sean Downey of Google sounded a lot like a network TV executive on Tuesday evening as he opened the second annual YouTube Creator Premieres content
body:
Sean Downey of Google sounded a lot like a network TV executive on Tuesday evening as he opened the second annual YouTube Creator Premieres content showcase in Hollywood.

	The event, held at the Hollywood Roosevelt hotel, showed off upcoming titles from such disparate stars as influencer Emma Chamberlain, director Wesley Wang, tennis superstar Aryna Sabalenka, musician and comedian Morgan Jay, chefs Nick DiGiovanni and Ina Garten and comedians Lilly Singh and Grace Reiter.
	

	Downey opened the hourlong presentation by stating the obvious — the definition of television has changed. He noted that the first Academy Awards was held in the same ballroom where a few hundred creators, influencers and journalists gathered. The studio system that defined who got on the air and into the multiplexes is under reconstruction.

	“Today, the studio are the creators who are in this room. They own the studio. The creators decide what gets to be shown and they have an unbreakable connection with the fans and people that want to watch their content,” Downey, who is president of Americas and global partners for Google.

	Of course, the sales pitch wasn’t far behind. The event was designed to warm up deals for big stars such as Chamberlain, Sabalenka and Wang as well as rising stars. “Brands and creators were built to be together,” Downey said. “They speak a language of trust and resonance.”

	The streaming pipeline controlled by YouTube also facilitates all the new dimensions of the digital economy, from second screen activity and community building to supporting vertical media, microdramas, e-commerce and livestream events.
	

	The event was hosted by Scott Evans, the former “Access Hollywood” co-host who has seen his YouTube business blossom with the success of his “House Guest” lifestyle series. YouTube unleashed a slew of trailers and teasers for shows rolling out through the end of the year and into the first quarter. Evans is getting a “House Guest” spinoff series that will find him traveling to visit homes in exotic locations, starting in January with a trek to Lagos, Nigeria.

	“This platform changed my life,” Evans told the crowd. In a different era, his TV career might have ended with the sunset of the NBC-produced daily entertainment newsmagazine series “Access Hollywood,” which ended this past fall. Instead, thanks to the opportunities afforded by YouTube, “I marched out of the mud and said ‘Finally, I’ve got more time.’ ” Evans said.

	Evans hosted short talk-show style interviews with Sabalenka, Wang and Chamberlain. Sabalenka, who already has an enormously popular YouTube channel, explained why YouTube is her favorite social media platform.

	“I tried bigger documentaries with Netflix” but the fit wasn’t right, Sabalenka said. “I wanted to have more control to tell the story the way I wanted to tell it. And I didn’t want to want one year for it to come out.”

	Wang told Evans that he has launched a new production banner designed to help showcase budding directors. A few years ago, one of Wang’s shorts caught the attention of executives at Sony Pictures. But Wang’s path has kept him close to YouTube. His list of projects includes a filmmaking competition series “Absolute Cinema,” which puts contestants through a seven-day filmmaking boot camp with Wang in the hopes of winning $100,000 to fund their films. He’s also spearheading the ambitious “Extraction 14” which is a murder mystery that challenges viewers to be the first to solve the case.

	Wang emphasized that YouTube is the platform of the future because it allows for directors to build a fan base that moves with them.

	“We want to build experiences, not just films,” Wang said. “We want people to watch the film and then talk about it on Reddit, on Discord. There’s a lot more opportunities for audience engagement.” 

	Among the trailers showcased was the latest movie parody from multihyphenate comedian Grace Reiter. “Twilight (but better),” coming in February, is a follow on the success of her “Hunger Games (but better)” parody released in 2025.
	

	Here is a rundown of all of the projects unveiled and content descriptions provided by YouTube:

	Nick DiGiovanni | “Chef” | New series

	Chef Nick DiGiovanni, the creator behind the world’s largest food YouTube channel, launches Chef (@Chef) — a new series from his production company, Knife Drop Studios. After reaching billions of viewers through his global culinary adventures (@NickDiGiovanni) and step-by-step recipes (@NicksKitchen), DiGiovanni is now turning the camera solely toward fellow professional chefs, offering an unfiltered look inside kitchens around the globe. From Michelin-starred restaurants and hidden street food gems showcased in full-length episodes, to POV recipes in short-form episodes, Chef puts viewers in the shoes of the people behind the scenes, offering a unique, captivating perspective for everyone from the culinary obsessed to the simply curious. You can view the first full-length episode, “Inside the World’s #1 Pizza Restaurant” now, only on YouTube, along with the first short-form POV episode, “Butter Chicken Shawarma.” New short-form POV episodes will debut daily across Nick’s newly-launched @Chef channel with full-length episodes rolling out throughout 2026-27 exclusively on YouTube.

	Morgan Jay | “Music Therapy with Morgan Jay” | New series premieres November 18 

	Music Therapy is an original YouTube series developed and produced by viral comedian and musician Morgan Jay and Ty Stafford of Austin-based creative agency Hello Party, financed by Live Nation Studios. In each episode, Jay plays musical therapist to a celebrity guest, blending unscripted conversation and improv with live songwriting before the pair close with an original song they create together. The result lands somewhere between a talk show, a comedy special and a live concert. The first season features Kam Patterson, Ron Funches, Mara Wilson, Brennan Lee Mulligan, Yung Gravy, Matt Friend, Abbey Romeo, Mark Smalls, Tony Jefferson, ASHBY, Josh Johnson and Mandal Mann. Music Therapy was created by Morgan Jay and Ty Stafford (Hello Party) and is directed by Stafford. Brooke Schley serves as showrunner and co-writes the series with Jay. Executive producers are Graham Sicalowski, Robin Rapino, Stella Bulochnikov, Brooke Schley and Matt Sadeghian. Watch the series trailer here.
	

	Emma Chamberlain | “What Are You Waiting For?” | New series premieres early 2027 

	Emma Chamberlain doesn’t like waiting in line — and wants to understand more about people who do. In this new ongoing series, what starts as an investigation of New York City’s most frequented lines unspools into a thoughtful and expansive meditation on subcultures, fandoms, and what makes our modern world tick. At once whimsical, profound and provocative, and underpinned by Emma’s singular POV, What Are You Waiting For? is a hilarious cultural commentary that not only asks what people are waiting for — but why. The series is executive produced by two-time Emmy and Golden Globe winner Joe Lewis, with Amplify Pictures (Fleabag, 100 Foot Wave) serving as the co-studio and production company.

	Grace Reiter | “Twilight (but better)” | New parody film premieres February 18

	Comedian, writer, and actor Grace Reiter (Saturday Night Live) is expanding her comedic universe with Twilight (but better), her second unscripted parody film. Reiter first made waves with her viral sketches and The Hunger Games (but better), which launched on YouTube in November 2025 and has garnered more than 18 million views. Now, alongside her work on SNL and her Netflix series Minimum Wage, Reiter brings her signature blend of spontaneous comedy, sharp satire, and irreverent humor to one of the most iconic franchises of a generation. Twilight (but better) is produced by But Better Productions. Grace Reiter serves as director with Andie Schlenker and Anderson Appleby as producers, and Cindy Schlenker as co-producer. Watch the teaser trailer here.

	Wesley Wang | 3 new projects

	“Response” | New short film premieres early 2027 in collaboration across the Wesley Wang and Jason RodeloYouTube channels

	In this new sci-fi horror short film, a routine welfare check at a remote desert preserve turns terrifying when four park rangers discover an otherworldly presence inside a woman’s tent, leaving the youngest ranger separated from his own body. Response is produced by Wesley Wang Media with Jason Rodelo serving as director and writer.

	“Extract 14” | New interactive series premieres spring 2027

	A new six-episode, interactive murder-mystery series that puts viewers in the role of detective, with $100,000 on the line for the first person to crack the case. Told through found footage, digital breadcrumbs and hidden clues woven throughout each episode, the mystery unfolds over six weeks on YouTube, challenging viewers to pause, rewind, decode and collaborate to uncover the truth. The first viewer to correctly solve the case wins $100,000! Extract 14 is directed and written by Wesley Wang and produced by Wesley Wang Media.
	

	“Absolute Cinema” | New competition series premieres spring 2027

	A new series where ten aspiring filmmakers, chosen from thousands of internet strangers, are brought to New York for an immersive, seven-day filmmaking bootcamp where they’ll compete for $100,000 to bring their dream movie to life. Guided by filmmaker Wesley Wang and a panel of Hollywood industry experts, contestants will take on every stage of the filmmaking process, culminating in a red carpet premiere where the viewers get the final say in choosing the grand prize winner. Absolute Cinema is produced by Wesley Wang Media.

	Aryna Sabalenka | “Aryna’s Arena: Unfiltered” | New series premiering spring 2027

	She’s the most dominant tennis player on the planet; and the world can’t look away. Aryna Sabalenka has spent years letting us watch her win. Now cameras follow her everywhere press passes don’t go. A Gucci ambassador designing her own $250K diamond necklace, a bride-to-be planning a wedding while living out of a suitcase for 300+ days a year, a daughter flying home to Belarus between slams, Aryna is building an empire in real time with the whole world watching. From UltraBoom Media, the creators of OFF DAY, a team led by Producers and Creatives from Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown, Aryna’s Arena: Unfiltered is an evolution and expansion of Aryna Sabalenka’s YouTube series (Aryna’s Arena). It is a docu-reality series that lives inside her world, on the court, on the road, and everywhere in between, capturing the brand meetings and dress fittings, the late nights with her fiance, and the quiet hotel room moments where she finally gets to just be herself. Raw and glamorous with the playfulness that is uniquely Aryna, this is an unfiltered voyeuristic portrait of power, identity, chaos, and the chosen family around her that makes it all possible.

	Track Star* | “Track Star Tonight” | New series now streaming, with new episodes rolling out this winter 

	Track Star* is a music-driven digital show hosted by Jack Coyne that brings artists and fans together. Expanding on its popular on-the-street game and Track Star Podcast, Track Star Tonight is a new, intimate live performance series featuring emerging and established artists in front of a small audience, blending live music, storytelling, and artist discovery. Following performances from artists including Remi Wolf, Kings of Leon, The Womack Sisters, Medium Build, and Florence Road, the series will continue to release new performances and collaborations through the end of 2026 and into 2027. Track Star* is produced by Public Opinion Corporation and created by Jack Coyne, Kieran Coyne and Henry Kornaros.
	

	Ina Garten | Happy Hour with Ina Garten: “Thanksgiving Special” | New special premieres November 25 at 6:00am ET 

	On November 25, Happy Hour will air a special Thanksgiving episode featuring past guests and friends of Ina, including Bobby Flay, Seth Meyers, Julia Louis-Dreyfus, Jennifer Garner and, of course, Jeffrey. Ina and her friends will answer listener questions, share Thanksgiving memories, and offer hosting tips to get you inspired before the big day. Happy Hour is part of the Vox Media Podcast Network. Ina Garten serves as host with Jenna Weiss Berman, Ali Jaffe Ramis and Deborah Davis as executive producers. Kate Tyler is contributing producer, with Jules Natt as producer and Mica Pollan Bahn as associate producer. Watch the series trailer here.

	Sam Eckholm | Access Granted: “Flying with the Royal Air Force Red Arrows” | New episode premieres November 27

	Access Granted is a cinematic documentary series that takes cameras to the world’s most secretive places, putting audiences inside demanding missions that have never been seen before. In an upcoming episode, host Sam Eckholm joins the Royal Air Force Red Arrows as Britain’s legendary aerial display team crosses the Atlantic to celebrate America’s 250th birthday, going behind the scenes with the pilots, the engineers, and the crew. Then he straps into the back seat of the lead jet and flies the full display, flying hundreds of miles per hour just a few feet from six other aircraft. Sam Eckholm is the creator and host of Access Granted with JoJo Phillips serving as executive producer and Swayne Martin as producer.

	Jon Youshaei | “Created with Jon Youshaei” | New episodes premiere this winter

	Created with Jon Youshaei is the award-winning docuseries where Jon goes behind the scenes with today’s biggest stars during their biggest moments. Think ESPN’s 30 For 30 docuseries, but about creators and celebrities. All access. No filters. In past episodes, Jon spent 45 days with MrBeast, shadowed Kevin Hart on set, and followed Steph Curry during All-Star Weekend. These upcoming episodes feature Jon as he spends another month on-set with MrBeast for Beast Games season 3 (including filming in the Colosseum in Rome), goes behind-the-scenes with Mark Rober on his new streaming show, and hits the road with Dude Perfect for their multi-million dollar arena tour. Created is directed and hosted by Jon Youshaei with Amanda Marcovitch serving as producer.
	

	Scott Evans | “House Guest Vacay” | New series premieres January 8

	Scott Evans is packing his bags and taking House Guest on the road with House Guest Vacay. In this new series, he’s bringing the laughs, candid conversations and unexpected moments to celebrity getaways across the country and around the world. His first stop in Lagos, Nigeria premieres January 8 exclusively on YouTube. House Guest Vacay is produced by Summer Break Studios and created and hosted by Scott Evans.

	Phil Rosenthal | “Somebody Feed Phil” | Season 9 premieres spring 2027

	Opa! Season 9 of Somebody Feed Phil kicks off in a destination long at the top of Phil’s wish list: Greece. On the island of Sifnos, globetrotting foodie Phil Rosenthal finally gets his first taste of the country, with sun-soaked tavernas, fresh-caught seafood and a warm welcome from new friends. It’s the start of a season of great meals, big laughs and more destinations to be revealed. The series won the 2022 Critics Choice Real TV Award for Best Travel/Adventure Show and earned a James Beard Award nomination. Rosenthal is the creator, executive producer and host of Somebody Feed Phil, a two-time New York Times bestselling author, and the creator of the Emmy-winning CBS comedy Everybody Loves Raymond. Somebody Feed Phil is produced by Lucky Bastards in partnership with Banijay Americas and Banijay Rights. Rich Rosenthal serves as executive producer and showrunner.

	Lilly Singh | “Eligible Aunties” | New series premieres 2027

	Eligible Aunties is a warm, funny, character-driven unscripted docu-follow series hosted by Lilly Singh that trades shallow villa romances for mature women with real emotional intelligence and emotional baggage. With Singh acting as the ultimate cheerleader and trusted confidante, the show follows a diverse cast of older single women navigating modern dating apps, new romance rules, and their meddling families. Directly serving a rapidly growing demographic of older unmarried adults craving real connections, the series highlights the joy and chaos of putting yourself back on the market. Ultimately, it proves that while finding love doesn’t get easier with age, it definitely gets more interesting. Eligible Aunties is produced by Unicorn Island Productions and created and hosted by Lilly Singh.

title: Don Toliver Announces Sixth Album ‘Nitrous,’ Due Next Month
description: Fresh off receiving five Grammy nominations, Don Toliver has announced that his sixth album “Nitrous” will be released on December 4 via Cactus Jac
body:
Fresh off receiving five Grammy nominations, Don Toliver has announced that his sixth album “Nitrous” will be released on December 4 via Cactus Jack/Donnway & Co/Atlantic Records.

	“Nitrous,” which Toliver has been teasing for some time, was recorded, produced and engineered entirely by himself. Toliver announced the album on social media with a clip that shows him working on music in something of a futuristic studio laboratory.



	To coincide with the album’s release, Toliver will make his “Saturday Night Live” debut on December 5. “Nitrous” features the new single “Party With the Boys,” which dropped this past Friday along with a Tyler Ross-directed video featuring Bam Margera.
	

	Toliver is coming off of a red-hot year in the wake of his fifth album “Octane,” which was released this past January and bowed atop the Billboard 200. The project featured the hit single “E85” that reached No. 3 on Billboard’s Hot R&B/Hip-Hop Songs chart and No. 15 on the Hot 100. The Houston rapper spent much of the year on the road as part of his “Octane World Tour,” which had a first run of arena shows from May to July before picking back up for a “Nitrous: New World Tour” addendum to the trek from August through the end of November, when he’ll wrap the shows at London’s O2 Arena.

	Yesterday, Toliver made waves with a substantial five nominations for the 2027 Grammy Awards. In addition to best new artist, Toliver was nominated for best rap album with “Octane”; best rap performance with “Body”; and best rap song and best melodic rap performance with “E85.”

              Rob Kardashian wanted to do something nice for a loyal family member ... so he contacted some people he knows and got her vintage vehicle fully torqued ... and it's all on video.
      
    
              Here's the deal ... Cici Bussey is Robert Kardashian Sr.'s cousin who has stayed close with Rob, his sisters, and Kris Jenner.
      
    
              Loyalty gets rewarded ... and Rob knows some people involved in the new reality show, "Fully Torqued: Unleashed" -- including host Steve Pazmany -- and he asked them if they'd fix up the 1963 230SL that Cici's owned for more than 20 years.
      
    
              The team got to work ... and you've gotta watch the clip to see the incredible results ... including the convertible top, new interior, paint touch-up, rechromed bumpers, upgraded stereo, and new tires.
      
    
              We're told the team kept everything time-period correct ... restoring it to the OG factory look.
      
    
      
        
              
    
    
              Cici -- who used to drive the car with her husband before his recent passing -- was clearly emotional when she saw the car ... and Rob told her in a FaceTime call he's just glad she's happy.
      
    
              On "Fully Torqued Unleashed" with Steve Pazmany, which features the host fixing up sick cars, which premieres November 20 on Prime. Other guests include DeAndre Hopkins, Gordon Ryan, and Brendan Schaub.
